drawPhase: Draw a card from the stock or discard pile
meldPhase: Lay down melds, then discard a card
forcedUse: A card taken from the discard pile must be used in a meld

tutorial.drawArea: Draw a card from the stock or discard pile. A card taken from the discard must be melded immediately.
tutorial.playerHand: This is your hand. Form sets (3+ same rank) or runs (3+ consecutive same suit).
tutorial.meldButton: Select 3+ cards and press Meld to lay a new set/run, or select a single card and press Layoff to add it to an existing meld. Meld out your entire hand to win.
tutorial.discardButton: After melding, discard one card from your hand.
tutorial.scoreTable: Each player's rounds won are shown here.
tutorial.resetButton: Press the reset button to start a new game.

frontendHint.conquianTakeDiscard: The discard connects with your hand — take it
frontendHint.conquianDrawStock: The discard connects with nothing — draw from the stock
